run_integration.meaning: Null means unmeasured; no H800 ratio or BF16 number may substitute. Existing closed engine/hardware/model objects remain closed. Evidence artifacts hold full resource time series and cache operation logs.
run_integration.observed_success_rule: For PASS records selecting tier/pool/hybrid_pool, all five artifact references are mandatory non-null, existing, hash-valid and capability-matched. Failed/blocked/planned records may retain incomplete references but grant no capability. Raw profiles explicitly declare inapplicable codec fields.

resource_contract_proposal.capacity_basis: One explicit physical-total or allocatable basis per domain; measured external GPU peak is deducted once under the preserved reserve rule.
resource_contract_proposal.peak_rule: max over operation phases of the union of all live physical allocations; distinct raw/encoded/copy allocations remain distinct; view aliases and pinning in place do not add bytes twice.
resource_contract_proposal.mapping_rule: resource_id + view_generation maps to exactly one physical_allocation and byte range. location_domain equals physical_allocation.medium. Views share a physical key; actual copies have distinct keys. Arena generation is independent. Reassigning a subrange increments view_generation even if physical allocation and arena do not change. Cache bindings describe producer evidence, not restorable pointers; restored resources receive fresh bindings.
resource_contract_proposal.physical_accounting_rule: allocated_bytes on the physical backing is charged once per physical key; reservations are charged only for unmaterialized additional capacity. Internal subrange ownership changes do not release the backing; retiring backing remains charged until completion and all references end.

transfer_contract_proposal.constraint: Already submitted DMA is not presumed preemptible. Each bounded chunk retains source and target leases until completion; optional work uses only remaining capacity.

semantic_rules.rule: Published checkpoint covers every source-bound state member with PERSIST, validated REBUILD or proven absence at the declared boundary; no unknown members.
Chunk references, exact token prefix, positions, logical slots and ranges are complete, nonoverlapping where required and consistent with commit cursor.
Persisted resource descriptors never serialize stale CUDA pointers, event/stream handles or module/function handles as restorable data.
Raw format, quantization blocks, scales, stride, valid bytes and codec profile are compatible; byte roundtrip hashes verified from actual data.
Storage block geometry cannot alter semantic prefill partition or per-loop/last-loop/lagged read policy. Such changes require new target identity and qualification.
A shorter prefix cannot reuse later conv/controller state; select a complete earlier checkpoint and replay or miss.

Cross-request model-prefix reuse does not share RNG, sampler history, grammar/stop/parser state or tool side effects without explicit request-specific rebuild. Request-continuation restore also verifies owner_session_id, logical_request_id, resume_generation and authoritative commit/effect journal; identical prompt/target/permissions do not identify the request.
Only committed/quiescent or independently qualified transactional snapshots can be published; tentative suffix and branch data remain private.
Every used codec has a bounded output policy, real raw fallback or reviewed worst-case reserve. An average or published ratio cannot authorize allocation.
GPU, host, SSD, scratch, staging, raw retention, COW, metadata, page slack, pinned copies and old/new graph/module generations are included in each transition peak.

All allocation aliases resolve to one physical identity; actual duplicate copies remain charged; same pinning/mmap backing pages are not charged twice. Join every resource via the canonical physical key and view_generation; arena_generation is independent. Reject unknown/conflicting mappings and stale suballocation views.
Restore and fallback both fit the unchanged profile budget before any data-changing submission; evictions require inactive status and completed leases.

Every transfer/encode/decode ticket has epoch, unique sequence, source/destination leases and explicit producer/consumer completion dependencies. Tickets bind physical key plus resource_id/view_generation/arena_generation, and must not retire a reused subrange.
Late completion cannot publish to another epoch. Unknown completion retains resources; asynchronous errors poison the affected context and prevent token/tool commit.
Lossless codec E evidence cannot substitute for Pool attention N evidence or target-changing Q evidence; frozen tolerance and original business quality gates remain required.
BF16 raw-vs-Pool comparison and Q8_0-vs-BF16 product comparison are different plans. Formal Mini and varloop draft/runner assets are never silently exchanged.
Loom source, CPU codec test, proof, compiled artifact, actual SM89 launch, model state and business evidence are distinct scopes; schema success grants none.
Selected feature dependencies are explicit and acyclic per experiment; unselected L/M/G/K/R tasks are not universal T12 dependencies.
Source/schema/artifact hashes reference existing files with matching content. No fabricated null replacements, empty test sets or synthetic performance may grant gate PASS.
Original 32 task IDs, 96 test IDs and all validation-policy values are preserved unless a documented fresh upstream fact supersedes a particular blocker; no gate is weakened.
Pool committed raw blocks survive encoding and publication until last raw readers complete; capacity failure never retracts emitted tokens; pending sealed set and new open tail count at peak.
Page-table/map update waits all prior readers; next graph replay waits update completion, or uses an independent generation. Stable pointer alone is insufficient.
Zero-suffix restore has a valid next-logits/readout recipe without forwarding the last consumed token twice; request continuation and cross-request model-prefix reuse have different state scopes.
Initial format is typed subrecords plus checkpoint directory; raw representation identity, exact valid byte ranges and full container/scratch/inflight budget are verified.
Overflow fallback has a finite retry/rebuild bound and a prequalified fitting raw profile, or terminates explicitly; recomputing the same data does not guarantee a better ratio.

Before continuation publication, the live coordinator verifies logical owner and resume generation against its authoritative commit/effect high-water marks. An older model checkpoint may only replay already committed inputs without re-emission/effect re-execution, or must fail. Runtime context/ticket epochs are freshly assigned and are not persistent ownership.

config.cache_profile is the only run cache extension. Reject legacy aliases, missing non-null artifact bindings for successful selected cache modes, and plans whose resolved hashes or capability identity differ from execution.

Resolve conditional tests from the frozen profile: native_dspark→LX27/T06; 2dsd→LX28/R03; loopcd_hidden or loopcd_logits→LX29/R04. Unselected cases do not grant capability; selected missing evidence blocks qualification.

Record ownership uses a logical checkpoint ID; the final directory hashes its complete member records. prior_checkpoint_digest, when present, points only to an earlier immutable checkpoint, never to the owning directory. Canonical serialization excludes no fields unless explicitly versioned.

discovery_to_inventory.unsupported: no publishable inventory item; blocks the chosen boundary

vocabulary_mapping.runtime_handle: DO_NOT_SERIALIZE_RUNTIME_HANDLE is a runtime-resource exclusion, not proof that required model state is absent
vocabulary_mapping.operation_states: Mutable/Sealed/Encoding/Restoring/Ready/Retiring/Aborted describe in-memory operations and leases, not an automatic one-to-one persistent enum mapping
